title: Podoroska secures spot in SP Open 2026 final
subtitle: The Argentine tennis star clinches the first WTA 250 final in São Paulo
excerpt: Nadia Podoroska, 29, secures her place in the SP Open 2026 final after defeating Paula Badosa, marking her first WTA 250 final.
author: Daniele Morais
contentHtml:
In the final round of the SP Open 2026, Argentine tennis player Nadia Podoroska secured her place in the WTA 250 tournament final in São Paulo. The 29‑year‑old athlete overcame Spain’s Paula Badosa to claim her first WTA 250 final of her career.

The road to the final

By defeating Badosa, Podoroska demonstrated consistency and strength on the court, advancing to the decisive match that will take place on Sunday. The match promises to showcase the player’s development within the elite of the women’s circuit.

With her spot confirmed, Podoroska will step onto the court to compete in a tournament that has already attracted top names from the global tennis scene. The SP Open 2026 continues to establish itself as a key event on the WTA calendar, offering opportunities for players at various levels.

With information from Agência Brasil.
